newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westfield Trust units top turnover.
newsitem.headline: Westfield Trust units top turnover.

text.p: Units in giant property trust Westfield Trust topped turnover on Thursday as 20.6 million units, or about 1.8 percent of the issued capital, traded by midday.
The bulk of trade was in two lines specialled through ANZ Securities, one of eight million and one of 10 million, both at A$2.72 per unit.
Macquaries Equities also specialled a line of two million units at A$2.74 each.
Brokers said the trade appeared to be normal institutional business. By 12.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), Westfield units were two cents higher at A$2.74 on turnover of 22.7 million units.
